title: Card payment declined: frozen or inactive card
content: Your card payment may be declined if your card is frozen or inactive. Open Cards, select the card used for the payment, and check its status. If it is frozen, follow the in-app steps to unfreeze it before trying again. Never share your PIN or card security code with support.

title: Declined card payment: balance and merchant checks
content: A card payment can be declined when the available balance is insufficient, a spending limit has been reached, or the merchant does not accept the card. Check your available balance, card spending limits, and whether the merchant accepts your card. If these look correct and the payment still fails, contact support with the merchant name and approximate time.

title: Declined card payment: next steps
content: If the payment still fails after you check the card status, balance, and limits, contact support. Include the merchant name and approximate time. Do not share your full card number, PIN, or CVV.

title: Transfer pending: check tracking status
content: Open the transfer details to review its status and expected arrival window. A pending status means the transfer is still being processed. Check the recipient details, and contact support if the expected arrival window has passed.

title: Transfer complete but recipient has no funds
content: If the transfer is marked complete but the recipient has not received the funds, confirm the recipient details and ask their bank to trace the payment. If the funds still have not arrived, contact support with the transfer reference.

title: Delayed transfer: escalation
content: Check the expected arrival window shown in the transfer details. If it has passed, contact support with the transfer reference so the payment can be investigated.

title: Lost or stolen card: secure the card
content: If your card is lost or stolen, freeze it immediately in Cards. If you cannot access the app, contact support using the phone number on the official website. Never share your login details in chat.

title: Lost or stolen card: replacement
content: Once your card is frozen, request a replacement from Cards. Available delivery options and any fee are shown before you confirm the request. Contact support if you do not see a replacement option.

title: Lost or stolen card: suspicious transactions
content: If you notice a transaction you did not make, freeze your card and report the transaction through the app. If you cannot access the app, contact support through an official channel.
